# China Trips - Full Content

Independent travel guide for China. Last verified: August 2026.

## About China Trips

China Trips is an independent travel guide created and maintained by travelers who have collectively spent years exploring China. Every itinerary, budget estimate, restaurant recommendation, and practical tip is based on firsthand experience. Not a tour agency. No sponsored rankings. No AI-generated filler. Contact: hello@china-trips.com.

## 8 Cities Covered

**Beijing** - History & Great Wall (3-5 days, best Apr-May/Sep-Oct)
Top experience: Great Wall at Mutianyu with cable car and toboggan.
Must eat: Peking Duck at Siji Minfu (四季民福), Zhajiang Noodles at Old Beijing Noodle King (老北京炸酱面大王), Mongolian Hot Pot at Donglaishun (东来顺).

**Shanghai** - City & Disney (2-4 days, best Mar-May/Oct-Nov)
Top experience: The Bund skyline at night.
Must eat: Xiaolongbao at Jia Jia Tang Bao (佳家汤包), Shengjianbao at Da Hu Chun (大壶春).

**Xi'an** - Terracotta Warriors (2-3 days, best Mar-May/Sep-Nov)
Top experience: 8,000 life-sized Terracotta Warriors.
Must eat: Yangrou Paomo at Tongshengxiang (同盛祥), Biangbiang Noodles at Muslim Quarter (回民街), Roujiamo at Fan Ji (樊记).

**Chengdu** - Pandas & Food (3-4 days, best Mar-Jun/Sep-Nov)
Top experience: Baby pandas at Chengdu Research Base (arrive 7:30am).
Must eat: Sichuan Hot Pot at Shujiuxiang (蜀九香), Mapo Tofu at Chen Mapo Tofu (陈麻婆豆腐).

**Zhangjiajie** - Avatar Mountains (2-4 days, best Apr-May/Sep-Oct)
Top experience: Glass bridge over Grand Canyon and Avatar floating mountains.

**Guilin & Yangshuo** - Karst Scenery (3-4 days, best Apr-Oct)
Top experience: Li River cruise, 83km of karst peaks.

**Yunnan** - Diverse Culture (5-7 days, best Mar-Jun/Sep-Nov)
Top experience: Tiger Leaping Gorge 2-day hike.

**Guangzhou** - Dim Sum Capital (2-3 days)
Top experience: Chen Clan Academy's Cantonese craftsmanship.

## Sample Itineraries

**Classic Golden Triangle (10 days)**: Beijing (4 days) -> Xi'an (2 days) -> Shanghai (3 days). $1,200-2,000.

**Pandas & Karst Peaks (14 days)**: Beijing -> Xi'an -> Chengdu -> Guilin -> Shanghai. $1,800-2,800.

**The Complete Journey (21 days)**: Beijing -> Xi'an -> Chengdu -> Zhangjiajie -> Guilin -> Yunnan -> Shanghai. $2,500-4,200.

## Budget Guide

- Budget: $50-100/day (hostels, street food, public transport)
- Mid-range: $100-200/day (3-4 star hotels, restaurants, Didi)
- Luxury: $250+/day (5-star hotels, private guides, fine dining)

## Visa Information

Most nationalities require tourist visa (L visa) before arrival. 55 countries eligible for 240-hour (10-day) visa-free transit across 24 provinces. Citizens of 40+ countries enjoy 30-day visa-free entry (Asia, Europe, Oceania, Americas). UK and Canada: 30-day visa-free trial through December 31, 2026. Check your embassy for latest rules.

240-hour eligible cities: Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, Shenzhen, Chengdu, Xi'an, Chongqing, Kunming, Xiamen, Qingdao, Wuhan, Hangzhou, Nanjing, Tianjin, Dalian, Shenyang, Guilin, Changsha, Harbin, Ningbo, Zhengzhou.

## Weather Guide

Best months: April-May, September-October. Avoid: July-August (hot/wet), Chinese New Year (chaotic transport).

Beijing: -9°C to 32°C. Shanghai: 1°C to 33°C. Chengdu: 3°C to 31°C. Guilin: 5°C to 33°C.

## Payment Setup

Alipay is essential. Download before departure, verify identity with passport photo, link Visa/Mastercard. WeChat Pay is backup option but stricter verification for foreigners. Cash rarely used in China.

## Transport

High-speed rail covers all major cities (G-trains at 300km/h). Book on Trip.com or 12306.cn. Metro in every major city (¥3-9/ride). Didi for ride-hailing (English interface available).

## Essential Phrases

- Hello: 你好 (Nǐ hǎo)
- Thank you: 谢谢 (Xiè xie)
- How much?: 多少钱？ (Duō shǎo qián?)
- Too expensive!: 太贵了！ (Tài guì le!)
- No spicy: 不要辣 (Bú yào là)
- The bill, please: 买单 (Mǎi dān)
- Delicious!: 好吃！ (Hǎo chī!)
- Where is the toilet?: 洗手间在哪里？ (Xǐshǒujiān zài nǎlǐ?)

## FAQ

Q: How many days for a China trip?
A: 10-14 days for first trip covering 3-4 cities. 7 days for Beijing only. 21 days for comprehensive tour.

Q: Is China safe?
A: Extremely safe. Violent crime against tourists is very rare. Standard precautions sufficient.

Q: Can I use credit cards?
A: Only at major hotels and upscale restaurants. Set up Alipay for everything else.

Q: Best time to visit?
A: Spring (Apr-May) and autumn (Sep-Oct) for mild weather. Avoid CNY and summer extremes.
